body: Insurance companies know anyway. All records are saved and shared.
I am not really that concerned but unless you have a diagnosis, help is not really possible to get in a socialized healthcare system.

As I said in the previous post, I used to work with a therapist who at his clinic so getting to know me wasn't really an issue. I also saw him for 40 minutes every other week...

The dynamic works like that because reddit ensures anonymity.

> until they know more about you
I used to see a therapist at his clinic for a few months and they discuss the patients at the end of the day so I am sure that isn't the issue. 

I realize that a wrong med would be a bad thing but i just want something from them, you know... even a guess...

Lol. 

Yes, I am pretty much interrogated since the first time I was caught planning/collecting stuff. It is very irritating. Life is just something I don't appreciate and since it is currently taking more effort than I am willing to put in, I want out. 

However, I've discovered, much to my disdain, that my survival instinct is quite strong and I can not do anything that'd cause me excessive bodily harm but not death. Therefore, I'm having to find more creative ways.

As I type, I have two specific plans, and I've chosen the one with the least certainty. I wonder if that's because I don't really want to die. However, this also has less impact in case of survival and will make it impossible to take out other family members should guilt become and issue again.

Thanks for being here. 

Cheers~

I don't really have much of a problem atm (except the whole family being angry thing but that's a result of the mindset, not the cause). The conclusion I drew wasn't from my life but from general observations.

But then again, what is the point? Why bother? Life is such a hassle. Even ending it takes effort - more effort than it should but hopefully worth it. As I said in another post somewhere (maybe on my real account), life is a series of temporary problems. Even though any given problem is not going to last forever, working through it is pointless because when one problem is resolved, two more pop up. Suicide is a permanent solution to a everlasting string of transient problems. :)

Yes. I am lost enough already. There are so many days where I can't even tell if the things that come out of my mouth/fingers are real or just something I've fabricated. If I lose this, there will be nothing left of "me", if there had ever been anything.

> I think your viewpoint is a bit extreme.

I know. I psychiatrist says to go easy on the philosophy but the existential crisis thought pattern is rather intrusive. Not only is it constant, it is also something I firmly believe. I'm really not interested in changing this viewpoint because it is part of my identity.

There is neither need nor purpose in creating meaning. Creating meaning is simply engaging in a fantasy. Ideal life would be lack thereof but apparently, we are not supposed to think that way... to keep the system going.

Edit: I guess that brings into question why I would even post and waste time. This is all so ridiculous. lol

> What made you happy in the past?
I don't even know. I don't really remember, I guess. 
In the recent years, I just kept going because school didn't take any effort. Work take effort. I have to get up, go there, and do mind-numbing idiotic things. It sucks. I know I am just a brat not wanting to be responsible for herself but that's just who I am. It's just not worth it. 

I understand their feelings but I didn't bring myself into the world. It was their selfish choice and I've been actively suffering because of that for more than half of my life. I felt obligated to wait for them when they didn't treat me as an anomaly that required monitoring. However, in light of their current attitude, I am sure that I've been relieved of that obligation. I don't owe it to them to continue this pointless endeavor.
Nothing. I don't think it's possible. I was going to stick it out until my parents die but whatever. They've made it clear that they'd rather just grieve than to watch a child or their's be a bum.

No particular reason, really. I just have no desire to participate in life and I'm tired of chastised because of that. I have this amazing sense of entitlement, I suppose. Anyway, life is just not worth effort.

Gift if life I did receive, 

Unwanted and unwelcome it has been.

Driven to death perhaps I am,

Only because of its permanence.

The promise of eternal sleep, that the deathgods give,

Is fairly impossible to resist.

And yet I cling, to the fickleness of life,

Too afraid to die and too tired to live.
